question.problem:
What is the quotient of $8{x}^{4}+24x+2$ divided by $-2{x}^{2}+3x-5?$

The quotient is
{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
Notice that the dividend is missing the ${x}^{3}$ and ${x}^{2}$ terms. So, we first rewrite it by including the missing terms with zero coefficients, as follows:

$$
8{x}^{4}+24x+2=8{x}^{4}+0{x}^{3}+0{x}^{2}+24x+2
$$

Now, using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,-4{x}^{2}-6x+1 \\  & -2{x}^{2}+3x-5\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,8{x}^{4}+\phantom{0}0{x}^{3}+\phantom{0}0{x}^{2}+24x+2\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{8{x}^{4}-12{x}^{3}+20{x}^{2}}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,12{x}^{3}-20{x}^{2}+24x+2 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,{12{x}^{3}-18{x}^{2}+30x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,-\,2{x}^{2}-6x+2 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,{-\,2{x}^{2}+3x-5}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,-\,9x+7\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

- the quotient is $-4{x}^{2}-6x+1,$ and

- the remainder is $-9x+7.$
